topic: Decoding Large Language Models and Transformers
target_audience: University students with basic programming knowledge

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept
lecture_lines: Embeddings map words to coordinate points.
Machines calculate distance between these vectors.
Conceptually similar words are placed close together.
animations: Create a coordinate grid with two points representing two words, each marked by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Draw a dashed line between the two points to represent the distance. Color: #FF00FF.
Move the two points closer together to show semantic similarity between the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/machine.svg] assets. Color: #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Transformer Core: Attention Mechanism
lecture_lines: Attention allows models to read words simultaneously.
It assigns importance weights to every word.
Context clarifies relationships between distant words.
The model focuses on relevant connections.
animations: Display three words appearing simultaneously on the screen accompanied by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/book.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Connect the words with lines of varying thickness to show attention weights. Color: #FFFF00.
Highlight a specific word by darkening its connections. Color: #FF0000.
Animate the connections shifting as the model processes context. Color: #00FF00.
Display a complex sentence structure collapsing into meaningful relationships, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/brain.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
lecture_lines: Scaling stacks many Transformer layers together.
Deep stacking captures subtle logic and nuance.
LLMs represent vast networks of knowledge.
animations: Create multiple rectangular layers stacked vertically using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/server.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Pulse each layer to show depth and nuance being captured. Color: #0000FF.
Expand the stack to show the vast network of knowledge using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/network.svg]. Color: #FF00FF.

sections.title: The Training Loop: Predicting the Next Token
lecture_lines: Training models predict the next token sequence.
Models minimize prediction errors using backpropagation.
Correct predictions reinforce internal weight adjustments.
Iterative learning enables human-like language generation.
animations: Show a sliding window over a token sequence using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/computer.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.
Calculate the error between the prediction and the target. Color: #FF0000.
Show the backpropagation signal adjusting internal weights. Color: #00FFFF.
Update the weights to minimize the error. Color: #00FF00.
Show the model producing more accurate predictions iteratively on the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/processor.svg]. Color: #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Real-world Application: Generative AI
lecture_lines: LLMs generate content by sampling probabilities.
Models evaluate the next most likely token.
Creative generation results from iterative prediction.

Highlight the most likely next token with a glow effect. Color: #FFFF00.
